messages.text: Sky announces Game Changing coalition for women and girls in sport

metadata.summary: Sky is pleased to announce the formation of the Game Changing coalition, a new UK initiative to drive lasting change for women and girls through increased participation in sport.
metadata.content: Sky announces Game Changing coalition to drive lasting change in UK for women and girls through sport | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Sky announces Game Changing coalition to drive lasting change in UK for women and girls through sport Sky has announced the Game Changing coalition for women and girls in sport; the group, convened by Sky, aims to improve participation of girls in comparison to their male counterparts; girls still spend 1.4 fewer hours playing sport than boys per week Tuesday 24 November 2026 11:53, UK Image: The Game Changing coalition is a new UK initiative to drive lasting change for women and girls through increased participation in sport Sky is pleased to announce the formation of the Game Changing coalition, a new UK initiative to drive lasting change for women and girls through increased participation in sport. Despite growing visibility and investment in women's sport, Sky's Game Changing report shows that girls still spend 1.4 fewer hours per week playing sport than boys - equivalent to every girl being sidelined for 52 football matches per year compared to their male counterparts. While landmark sporting moments have captured the nation's imagination, this surge in interest has not translated into enough girls regularly engaging in sport.
